mapper.sql: id, model_code, model_name, model_desc, model_type, data_source, status, version, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM model_info WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM model_info WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id FROM model_info WHERE model_code = #{modelCode} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_info ( model_code, model_name, model_desc, model_type, data_source, status, version, creator, updater, deleted ) VALUES ( #{modelCode}, #{modelName}, #{modelDesc}, #{modelType}, #{dataSource}, #{status}, 1, #{creator}, #{updater}, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE model_info SET model_code = #{modelCode}, model_name = #{modelName}, model_desc = #{modelDesc}, model_type = #{modelType}, data_source = #{dataSource}, status = #{status}, version = #{version}, updater = #{updater}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE model_info SET deleted = 1, updater = #{updater}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE model_info SET model_code = #{modelCode}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
